description: This file contains functions for managing backend storage in etcd, including opening, recovering, and snapshot handling.

methods.name: newBackend
methods.description: Creates a new backend storage instance with configuration settings.

methods.name: OpenSnapshotBackend
methods.description: Renames a snapshot database file to the current etcd database and opens it.

methods.name: OpenBackend
methods.description: Opens the current etcd backend database.

methods.name: RecoverSnapshotBackend
methods.description: Recovers the backend database from a snapshot if the current index is outdated.
